description: Connect a Google Drive folder of recordings so storyflo can match them to episodes automatically — the alternative to uploading a back catalogue file by file. Call with NO folder argument first to get the setup instructions, including the address to share the folder with. Then call again with folder=<the Drive URL>. Recording the connection moves no audio; the scan happens afterwards.

folder.description: Google Drive folder URL or id. Omit to get setup instructions.

name: publisher_connect_folder
title: Connect a recordings folder
